actor.name: structural-engineer
actor.description: Site investigation and structural calculations across both registers

payload.assessmentNotes: Good ground conditions. Free-draining gravel subsoil with adequate bearing capacity for single-storey construction. Water table well below foundation formation level. Conventional strip foundations recommended at 600mm depth.

payload.engineerNotes: Timber-frame structure designed to BS EN 1995-1-1 (Eurocode 5). Strip foundations at 600mm depth on gravel formation. All structural elements have adequate safety margins.
